description: A quarter-turn winder stair: 4 risers east, 3 winders in the 900 mm square at the turn, and 7 straight treads north, to its head at (2200 mm, 2800 mm). Its rise, risers and box are derived - the box spans its first flight, the square and its second flight - and its steps, run, walkline and headroom are not: FS-LINT-016, an info.
